nsus, hæc Gregorij verba quaternio novus in

novus adnexus, habens Canones quasi Apostolicos

page.notes: The note "Greg. Tur. Hist. li. 5. c. 18." is printed in three short lines in the margin, and is shown here as one note. The paragraph is taken as one continuous paragraph: no clear indent is visible before the italic block "Ipse vero", so it may be a separate paragraph in the printed book. The last word is printed as "re:" on its own right-aligned line after "duce-", and is kept as the completion of the broken word. Printed "xxvi." is in small capitals and is copied in lower case as it appears.
